reserveReview.rationale: At Rootstock block 9361378 (hash 0xa875c5141fc7534164071c2726f48354edf30d3e820d3c6165aab21d0d282876, 2026-10-27T16:14:24Z), canonical MoC custody (eth_getBalance), MoCState collateralRbtcInSystem() and rbtcInSystem() all report 269.977582443789970 rBTC (0xea2b10cd480d6757f wei). DOC supply is 2,886,103.992468493 from both MoCState docTotalSupply() and the DOC token totalSupply(), and the valid protocol BTC oracle reports $80,387.70, giving 7.519783x coverage (globalCoverage() agrees). globalLockedBitcoin() reserves 35.902308344 rBTC for senior DOC claims and getRbtcRemainder() reports 234.075274100 rBTC of residual risk capital; state() is 3 (above the target coverage) and paused() is false. All four reviewed proxy implementation slots (MoC 0xfaf8b802c934af857b58471b6daa66dc5d8a7d07, MoCState 0xe348149646f721ff5e5eb47692299b3796d0b7ed, connector 0x437221b50b0066186e58412b0ba940441a7b7df5, oracle 0xa7e86af8eb19e3dab8e7353cb27d286372aac87d) are unchanged at this block. The book remains a single rBTC slice, so the 100% weight is structural and unchanged; no composition percentages are published. BPRO bears the residual Bitcoin exposure rather than a second fixed-dollar liability; the full accounted collateral is therefore the correct system coverage numerator, not a DOC-only wallet and not raw unaccounted donations. The live adapter pins reviewed implementation identities, reconciles state DOC supply against the canonical token, checks oracle validity and accounting at one block, caps admitted backing at the actual custody balance, and degrades custody deficits, undercoverage, pause or liquidation. Implementation review 2026-09-26: governance upgrade tx 0x30983b6767dc7807f87d9f31f6a4b6f9c68c74c192e38a6b9794690cc00bf495 (via the MoC VotingMachine proxy, Rootstock block 9271198) rotated the MoC and MoCState proxies to the Blockscout-verified money-on-chain@3.0.7 implementations 0xfaf8b802c934af857b58471b6daa66dc5d8a7d07 and 0xe348149646f721ff5e5eb47692299b3796d0b7ed (byte-identical to GitHub tag v3.0.7). Diffed against the pinned 0.1.14 sources, every adapter-read function (collateralRbtcInSystem, rbtcInSystem, docTotalSupply, getBitcoinPrice, getBtcPriceProvider, globalLockedBitcoin, getRbtcRemainder, globalCoverage, state, freeDoc, getLiq, getPeg, getProtected, reserve/moc precisions, getBucketNBPro for X2, connector, paused) is byte-identical and the proxy storage layout is preserved (the retired MoCEMACalculator block-span slots are kept as deprecated words and the 50-slot gap shrank to 48); the only deltas — EMA scheduling moving to a one-day timestamp span and removal of the MoC getBitProInterestBlockSpan passthrough — touch no read the adapter depends on, and the verified deployed MoCState still returns accounted rBTC as total collateral because X2 leveraged positions remain disabled with a zero nBPro count.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Canonical Rootstock MoCState accounted rBTC, DOC supply and protocol-valid BTC oracle at one block (9361378); custody balance and senior DOC/junior BPRO accounting reconciled
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The only backing asset class is rBTC. Protocol oracle valuation, Rootstock peg/custody and upgrade risks remain; BPRO residual risk capital is shared system collateral, not a separately guaranteed DOC reserve. Ethereum and Arbitrum DOC representations are not additional collateral or additional canonical DOC liabilities.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: All collateral sits in the single MoC system contract, an upgradeable proxy, so contract-admin action is the operative custody risk rather than a custodian. The 2026-08-23 Rootstock read confirms the current balance at the MoC address; no legal segregation, bankruptcy-remoteness, or rehypothecation terms exist for contract custody. Public code audits in the official repository date to 2019.
